entries.title: Exodus 31:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 31:2
segments: Behold, I, I have called by name Bezaleel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

entries.title: Exodus 31:3
segments: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all workmanship,

entries.title: Exodus 31:4
segments: to devise designs; to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

entries.title: Exodus 31:5
segments: and in cutting of stones, to set [them], and in carving of timber, to work in all workmanship.

entries.title: Exodus 31:6
segments: And behold, I have given to him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And I have put wisdom in the hearts of all the wise-hearted, so that they may make all that I have commanded you:

entries.title: Exodus 31:7
segments: the tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy-seat that [is] upon it, and all the vessels of the tabernacle,

entries.title: Exodus 31:8
segments: and the table and its vessels, and the pure lampstand with all its vessels, and the altar of incense,

entries.title: Exodus 31:9
segments: and the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the laver and its base,

entries.title: Exodus 31:10
segments: and the woven garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

entries.title: Exodus 31:11
segments: and the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy [place]. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.

entries.title: Exodus 31:12
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

entries.title: Exodus 31:13
segments: Speak also to the sons of Israel, saying, Truly you shall keep My sabbaths. For it [is] a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, to know that I [am] the LORD who sanctifies you.

entries.title: Exodus 31:14
segments: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it [is] holy to you. Everyone that defiles it shall surely be put to death. For whoever does [any] work in it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.title: Exodus 31:15
segments: Six days may work be done, but on the seventh [is] the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does [any] work in the Sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 31:16
segments: Therefore the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, [for] an everlasting covenant.

entries.title: Exodus 31:17
segments: It [is] a sign between Me and the sons of Israel forever. For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He rested, and was refreshed.

entries.title: Exodus 31:18
segments: And He gave to Moses, when He had made an end of speaking with him upon Mount Sinai, two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written by the finger of God.
